name: caspase 8
pathways: negative regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction
positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: CASP8 encodes caspase-8 [Cleaved into: Caspase-8 subunit p18; Caspase-8 subunit p10]. Annotated molecular activities include peptidase activity and cysteine-type endopeptidase activity. It participates in negative regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome type 2B (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma; Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma; Invasive Breast Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
